svg.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
svg.text: PR #2174 · Add plugin validate and preview commands
Manifest mistakes only surfaced after installing and launching a session;
now validate and preview check a plugin directory offline, so authors and CI catch them first.
BEFORE
AFTER
agent-portal-plugin.toml (author's view)
load_manifest: toml::from_str, unknown keys ignored
{outdir} typo -> passed to sh literally
detect any = ["main/*.c"] -> file names only, never fires
[[skills]] path missing -> silently skipped at launch
found only after install + setup + launching a session
How the plugin looks in Portal
no way to see the card, context cost, or dock size
no way to ask "would Portal suggest this here?"
before running plugin install
agent-portal plugin validate PATH [--json]
errors: name, missing files, empty run, unknown {placeholder}
warnings: unknown keys, broad / path-shaped detect patterns
warnings: no homepage, license, [compat], install.doctor
exit 1 only on errors; nothing installed or executed
agent-portal plugin preview PATH [--cwd DIR]
card: name, description, homepage, license, source
skills/prompts with sizes; commands; dock title + width
--cwd: plugin_detect::detect_reason -> suggested + reason
plugin_detect.rs: the one matcher preview + inventory share
validation findings listed at the bottom
Static checks only: setup and doctor are never run, and {artifact_dir}/{backend_url} only warn because the launcher does not expand them yet.
